answer_1.quote: We develop and rigorously evaluate two separate strategies: a generation approach to generate content of different credibility news source categories and a translation approach, which involves converting deceptive tweets to credible and vice versa while preserving the meaning.
datasets: 319K tweets from 231 deceptive news accounts, and 1M tweets from 340 credible news accounts
answer_1.outputs: generated news content and translated tweets between credible and deceptive styles

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of the models that were conditioned on only the news source category... we calculate the BLEU scores of both real and generated tweets from a given news source category with the same category and with different categories.
